podcast.title: Acting Debut (2007)
podcast.body: Willow debuted as an actress alongside her father, Will Smith, in the 2007 movie "I Am Legend." "She's an actor having debuted with Dad in the movie I Am Legend back in 2007."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Collaboration with Travis Barker
podcast.body: For her 2021 album, Willow collaborated with Travis Barker of Blink-182 to infuse a pop-punk sound into her music. "she switched things up a bit into a more pop punk vein with help from Travis Barker of Blink 182."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Early Pop Success
podcast.body: At the age of 10, Willow achieved significant pop success with her single "Whip My Hair," which became a top 15 hit. "At age 10, she released a single called With My Hair, which became a top 15 pop hit."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Prolific Collaborator and Producer (2015-2022)
xref.body: Over a seven-year period, Travis Barker became a highly active collaborator and producer, appearing on numerous records. His extensive list of collaborations includes artists such as Young Blood, The Game, M&M, Stevie O'Kee, LL Cool J, Pitbull, Lights, Kenny Hoopla, Machine Gun Kelly, Halsey, Willow Smith, and Dirty Heads. "Travis Barker seemed willing to collaborate and produce just about anyone, and he would appear in a ton of records over the next seven years."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Diverse Fanbase
xref.body: Her fanbase is wide-ranging, including prominent figures like Billie Eilish, Ed Sheeran, Charlie XCX, Willow Smith, and Olivia Rodrigo. Even Rob Halford of the metal band Judas Priest openly expresses his admiration for Avril Lavigne. "Fans include Billy Eilish, Ed Sheeran, Charlie XCX, Willow Smith and Olivia Rodrigo, even Rob Hulford of Judas Priest says he's a fan of Avril Lavigne."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
